technicalDebt.item: Appointment form is mock-only; lead data is not stored or forwarded.
dist/ directory contains stale build with old Blackline Auto / Islamabad branding.
8.2MB uncompressed JPEG images without WebP/AVIF variants.
@types/react-router-dom v5 installed alongside react-router-dom v7 in dependencies.
Low resolution visual assets for Ferrari, Lamborghini, and studio facility.
Hardcoded location strings in JSX bypassing studioConfig.ts.
Unused assets hero.png, react.svg, and vite.svg in src/assets/.

risks.issue: Customer leads submitting the booking form are lost permanently.
Deploying directly from dist/ will publish the old Blackline Auto template.
Unverified warranty and experience numbers carry false advertising risks.
8.2MB payload impairs mobile 4G page speed scores and increases bounce rate.
Footer social links redirect users away to generic platform homepages.
